name: Upper East Coast Fringe
summary: Edges of Upper East Coast toward Siglap / Bedok — east-coast adjacent living with quieter residential texture and ActiveSG catchment.
body: Upper East Coast Fringe is the shortlist when east-coast adjacency and quieter residential texture matter more than CBD skyline premiums. The pocket sits on the Upper East Coast / Siglap / Bedok edges; housing mixes mid-age condos, walk-ups, and selective landed. Expats land here for car-light hops to town and ActiveSG lawn-bowls / circuit catchment without Orchard rents. Watch-outs: roof-access / cat-ladder permit notices on mid-rises, weekend beach-road traffic, and confusing Upper East Coast vs Upper East Coast Fringe shortlists. Compare with Lagoon View West for denser condo texture, Mandarin Gardens East for estate-edge living, and Siglap Fringe when cafe strips win.
